how: For each case: serve directory at /.well-known/http-message-signatures-directory and rotation (or the case's crawlcheck.rotation) at /.well-known/security-key-rotation.json, and answer POST /api/v1/preflight with crawlcheck (status + body or text; unreachable = refuse the connection; by_op = the receipt for the operation asked, keyed "METHOD url"). Call the guard with request (pin nonce and now - request.now, which some key-policy cases move past 2026-11-09 17:00 UTC; pass operation when given). A fetch case also serves sites (url -> status, location, body) and records each URL the guard requested and which domain got the CrawlCheck-Receipt header. expect.proceed must match; for fetch cases, fetched must match exactly.
